definition: Both markets on the same complete186-month cohort of current exact-area stock. Household-weighted Carli100*sum(N*P(t)/P(base))/sum(N). Research comparator, not the adopted chained sale index or official KB index.
calendar: 2011-01 through2026-06. Monday in the week containing15th, then completed Thursday.
price_policy: Retain available native weak/stale prices and KB-only same-complex same-date nearest-area correction. Exclude known post-start construction; unknown build years eligible. Current surviving inventory weights.
coverage: Shared cohort divided by all currently known positive complex households, including stock without mapped exact area. Unknown household totals are outside denominator. Closed10percentage-point ranges.
support: At least100households,10complexes,20%inventory coverage. Each complex <=20% of household mass and of every monthly index contribution. No strict comparison values released.
precision: Indices and changes0.1. Directions use unrounded12-month changes: flat[-0.5,+0.5], up>0.5, down<-0.5. No exact counts, IDs, native prices or constituent contributions.
limitations: Retrospective matched surviving stock; incomplete market representation and no historical information vintage.
No cohort met normal conditions throughout both markets; strict comparison unavailable.
Index differences are not price levels, jeonse ratios, causal effects or leading forecasts.
